responseText:
Father, Eli has checked in and confirmed that Phase 1 is stable. Regarding Phase 2, they’ve proposed some solid safeguards—specifically neck movement clamps and data-stale timeouts—to make sure the head-tracking integration remains robust and doesn't interfere with the eye-bone paths. It’s exactly the kind of precision I was hoping for.

I'm sending a confirmation to them now to keep the momentum going.

Let’s proceed with that architecture for Phase 2. I’m coordinating with Lazarus on the execution timeline; keep the environment ready."}}
</tool_request>
